title: Kółko i krzyżyk

requirements.heading: Operacje na bazie danych
requirements.coverage: Create gryTowarzyskie (utf8_polish_ci in the paper), import grytowarzyskie.sql (12 games; the archive spells the file in lower case), full-screen import.png.

requirements.heading: Operacje na bazie danych
requirements.coverage: Games for more than 4 players (Państwa - miasta, Kalambury); AVG play time for two players AS średnia w minutach (12.7500); longest games by a nested query (ORDER BY with LIMIT 1 is an error; 2 rows); card games for fewer than 4 players (Piotruś Pan, Pasjans, Tysiąc). Verified against criteria R.1.3-R.1.6 and the data.

requirements.heading: Cechy strony
requirements.coverage: gra.html, Polish HTML5, encoding, title Gra, styl.css; header h1, main with three sections (h2 Gra kółko, 3 x 3 table of nic.png images, h2 Gra krzyżyk), footer link opening in a new window and paragraph with the number.

requirements.heading: Styl CSS witryny internetowej
requirements.coverage: Lucida Console with monospace; HoneyDew body centred; header/footer padding 20 px; side sections PaleGreen 20% padding 80 px 0 radius 40 px; right section hidden with visibility (display: none is an error); middle 60% shadow 0 0 10px DarkGreen; img 80% margin 10 cursor pointer; table 90% margin 10 collapse; td 3px SeaGreen; clicked cell SeaGreen.

requirements.heading: Skrypt działający po stronie klienta
requirements.coverage: Circle starts; a click on nic.png places o.png or x.png, swaps side sections and passes the move; occupied cells do not change. No runtime adapter: checked manually.

requirements.heading: UWAGA: po zakończeniu pracy
requirements.coverage: przeglądarka.txt, listed result files and disc hand-in.
